A '''triumph ceremony''' in honor of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] hero [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was held on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 ABY]]. It was organized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] with the intention of recognizing Chewbacca's influential role in their decisive victory against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
[[File:Chewie-What_is_a_Wookiee.png|thumb|left|150px|Chewbacca, a hero of Yavin, was honored on his own planet.]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]&mdash;a [[Moon/Legends|moon]]-sized [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] which was meant to be the ultimate weapon in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] arsenal&mdash;at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Following the victory over the Empire, a [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|ceremony]] in honor of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] was held at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] awarded the heroes of the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Bravery]], the highest military honor the Alliance gave.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Although he did receive his own medal in private after the official ceremony,<ref name="TDADS">{{StoryCite|story=The Day after the Death Star!|book=Star Wars Weekly 97}}</ref> the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] didn't place any meaning in it, as members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] did not care for tangible awards.<ref name="BTM" />

However, members of the Alliance did not wish to appear ungrateful toward one of its new figureheads. In order to officially recognize Chewbacca's contribution to the victory at Yavin, a large delegation of Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officers]] was sent to the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where a huge celebration was held<ref name="BTM" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Fellow heroes [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Leia Organa and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] all attended this event, which brought honor to Chewbacca and his entire species.<ref name="BTM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|According to interviews conducted shortly after the release of ''A New Hope'', George Lucas maintained that the Rebels had participated in a celebration on Chewbacca's homeworld in lieu of an actual medal.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider95">{{InsiderCite|95|May The Facts Be With You: Part Two|May The Facts Be With You: Part Two: #51-100}}</ref>}}
[[File:Chewie_medal.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Chewbacca receives his Medal of Bravery in private.]]
This celebation on Kashyyyk was first mentioned in a [[1977]] interview, in which ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] explained why Chewbacca did not receive his own medal at the end of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. This feast on the Wookiee planet was only mentioned in the interview, but never made any real appearance in narration in any form of ''Star Wars'' media. However, the existence of the Kashyyyk celebration was confirmed in the [[1998]] CD-ROM ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''.<ref name="BTM" />

In the [[1980]] short comic ''[[The Day after the Death Star!]]'', Chewbacca did receive the Medal of Bravery in private on Yavin 4, at the insistence of both Han Solo and Luke Skywalker.<ref name="TDADS" /> However, this fact does not contradict the existence of the Kashyyyk celebration, and the declarations coming directly from Lucas are considered the highest level of [[canon]]icity.<ref name="Leland">{{Blog|listing=true|holocron}}</ref> The present article thus considers both events canon.
